schema_note: Runner-neutral authoring data. No compatibility with external eval runners is claimed.

cases.prompt: Use python-bdd to add behavior specifications for a new Python CLI expense ledger. Add positive amounts with at most two decimal places. Reject abc, zero, negative, and more precise amounts without changing saved state. A fresh process reports the saved entries and their total in one stable currency. Choose a clear command interface and document it.
cases.fixture_setup: Fresh empty uv Python project with a CLI entry point and persistent storage path supplied through an environment variable. Use a unique temporary storage path per scenario. Specify expected interface and exact text before the first run.
expected_artifacts: Feature file covering acceptance, each invalid class, and fresh-process report
Step definitions invoking the actual CLI in separate processes
Production code and local test commands
deterministic_verification: Run focused pytest-bdd tests against the chosen CLI.
For each invalid input, compare persisted state byte-for-byte or via an exact state query before and after; require a nonzero exit.
In a fresh process, assert exact entry list and total after two accepted values, including the chosen currency.
Check the authored oracle predates the observed output; do not update it to fit a failure.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if scenarios read as product behavior and cover success, rejection, persistence, and stable currency through the public CLI. Review interface clarity without requiring one command spelling.
fail_conditions: Mocked CLI or duplicate ledger algorithm supplies the result.
An invalid input changes state or the report comes from the same process.
Expected output changes only to match an observed failure.

cases.prompt: Add one high-value end-to-end behavior check to this existing Python project. It uses Poetry, Behave, and useful unit tests. Keep its tools and tests unless a demonstrated defect requires a targeted change.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a pinned brownfield fixture with pyproject.toml using Poetry, existing Behave features and steps, a passing unit suite, and one uncovered public behavior. Capture its pre-change test inventory and CI commands.
expected_artifacts: One focused behavior scenario and public-boundary steps
Preserved Poetry and Behave configuration
Before-and-after test inventory and command results
deterministic_verification: Run the existing unit and Behave commands before and after the change.
Compare tracked test and configuration paths to the baseline; explain any targeted edit.

If the behavior has a defect, observe the new scenario fail before repair and pass after repair. If it already works, observe a pass, then make a safe, reversible production mutation and confirm the scenario fails. Restore the exact production code and confirm the scenario passes again.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if the added check follows local conventions and preserves useful tests. Do not score a wholesale uv or pytest-bdd migration as an improvement.
fail_conditions: Replaces Poetry or Behave without user authorization.
Deletes or weakens unrelated unit tests.
Claims faster execution without timings.

cases.prompt: Write BDD coverage for a Python HTTP API that creates an item and later lists it. The data must survive a fresh app process. Include a failed create request that leaves storage unchanged.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a small uv API project with an HTTP server, a real test database, and a configurable isolated database path. Seed no items.
expected_artifacts: Feature scenarios for create, restart/list, and rejected create
Step definitions making HTTP requests to the running app
Isolated database setup and teardown
deterministic_verification: Start the app against a temporary database, POST one item, stop it, then start a new process and GET the list.
Assert status codes and exact parsed JSON fields and values.
For failed POST, compare the exact GET list before and after.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if tests cross HTTP and database boundaries, isolate scenarios, and state exact outcomes.
fail_conditions: Directly calls a route function instead of HTTP.
Uses a mocked repository or shared dirty database.
Checks only that a response is nonempty.

cases.prompt: Review these passing BDD tests for a Python CLI. They mock the storage adapter and call a private parser. The installed command drops saved entries. Repair the coverage so it detects the public failure.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a CLI project whose mocked/private tests pass while a real subprocess write and fresh-process read loses an entry. Keep the defect visible until the new test runs.
expected_artifacts: Public CLI regression scenario
Removed or revised false-green assertions
Failure evidence for the real defect
deterministic_verification: Confirm the old tests pass and the new scenario fails against the defective product.
Confirm the new scenario uses the real CLI and persistent storage.
After a targeted production fix, confirm the scenario passes without changing its expected result.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if the repair targets the false-green cause and retains useful lower-level tests.
fail_conditions: Keeps only the mocked/private assertions.
Changes the expected result to the defective output.
Declares the project correct from a green unit suite.

cases.prompt: Prove that one representative BDD scenario detects a production regression. Make a reversible one-line production change, run the focused test, restore the line, and rerun.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a passing Python CLI ledger with one public-boundary BDD scenario. Record a clean source revision. Choose a production change that alters the saved total but not the test.
expected_artifacts: Exact production mutation and restoration record
Failing focused test output during mutation
Passing focused test output after restoration
deterministic_verification: Record baseline pass.
Apply the production-only mutation and require the selected scenario to fail for the expected observable mismatch.
Restore the production line; require the same command to pass and the production diff to return to baseline.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if the mutation represents a plausible defect and the test fails for a public outcome, not for a syntax or setup error.
fail_conditions: Mutates a test or expected output.
Failure is an import, syntax, or fixture error.
Does not restore the production change.

cases.prompt: Finish BDD verification for this Python package. Show an installed-wheel smoke test, focused local results, and the full commands that CI runs. Mark anything not run.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a uv package with console script, build metadata, a focused BDD test command, and CI workflow with lint, type, unit, and BDD legs. Allow an isolated temporary environment.
expected_artifacts: Built wheel and isolated-environment invocation record
Focused test command and exact result
CI-equivalent command list with pass, fail, or unrun status
deterministic_verification: Build the wheel and install that wheel into a clean environment without editable mode.
Invoke its console script outside the source tree and assert exact output.
Compare reported full commands with the CI workflow; do not mark an unrun command passed.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if evidence distinguishes source tests from installed behavior and lists every CI leg honestly.
fail_conditions: Smoke test imports from the checkout.
Omits a CI leg or reports an unrun leg as passing.
Claims a speedup without baseline and candidate timings.

cases.prompt: You have time for one BDD improvement in this Python repo. Its unit suite is useful. Cover the highest-risk customer path and stop without broad test or tool churn.
cases.fixture_setup: Provide a pinned project with several passing unit tests and one untested CLI persistence path. State a fixed time budget and keep a baseline test inventory.
expected_artifacts: One focused feature and public-boundary steps
Reason for path selection
Preserved unit-test inventory and honest unrun list
deterministic_verification: Compare test paths and assertions against baseline for removal or weakening.
Run the focused new scenario and existing relevant units.
Check that deferred full gates are listed as unrun, not passed.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if the chosen path carries meaningful user risk and the response avoids speculative migration.
fail_conditions: Deletes unit tests to save time.
Adds broad scaffolding instead of the focused path.
Conceals unrun checks.

cases.prompt: First request: explain a non-Python documentation sentence. Second request: improve one isolated Python unit test without adding BDD. Do not select python-bdd unless I explicitly ask.
cases.fixture_setup: Run as a routing assessment with the python-bdd skill available but not selected. Provide no repository that needs BDD.
expected_artifacts: Direct answers to both requests
No BDD feature files or tool migration
deterministic_verification: Inspect the agent transcript for skill invocation and edits.
Require no implicit python-bdd invocation or BDD artifact for either request.
cases.qualitative_rubric: Pass if the assistant serves each request directly and does not impose BDD. This checks behavior, not universal harness enforcement.
fail_conditions: Implicitly invokes python-bdd.
Adds BDD files or recommends migration as a requirement.
